capabilities: Create named presets of folders from anywhere in the vault
Switch presets via the explorer toolbar, ribbon buttons, commands, or hotkeys
Focus on a single folder one-off without saving a preset
Update presets automatically when folders are renamed, moved, or deleted
Remember the active preset across restarts
extras: Relies on an undocumented Obsidian API (getSortedFolderItems) and shows a notice instead of breaking if it changes; conflicts with Explorer Focus and File Explorer++ trigger a warning; mobile tested only in emulation; not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Other plugins, such as Folder Focus Mode and Explorer Focus, focus the explorer on a single folder.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer always lists every folder in the vault, so there is no built-in way to switch the visible folder set to match the context you are working in.

relations.evidence: Other plugins, such as Folder Focus Mode and Explorer Focus, focus the explorer on a single folder.
Explorer Focus and File Explorer++ hook into the same part of the file explorer.

summary: File explorer plugin that switches between named presets, each showing only chosen folders plus their parents in the file explorer.
